name: fu-claude-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code tooling: error-tracking sweep, PR review, the fu-skills scenario-skill bundle (pg/mssql/k8/pup/order/wsl/ce), dev guards, and a status line.

plugins.name: fu-et-sweep
plugins.description: Sweep a service's Datadog Error Tracking into de-duped GitHub issues with drafted root-cause writeups.

plugins.name: fu-log-sweep
plugins.description: Sweep a service's Datadog error-level Logs into de-duped GitHub issues with drafted root-cause writeups, deduping on a computed error signature.

plugins.name: fu-review-prs
plugins.description: Automated PR review orchestrator. Posts COMMENT reviews by default; --auto-approve opts into approving clean PRs.

plugins.name: fu-skills
plugins.description: All fu- scenario skills in one plugin: fu-pg (Postgres via Vault), fu-mssql (SQL Server, Windows auth), fu-k8 (k8dash proxy inspection), fu-pup (Datadog pup CLI), fu-order (Orders API), fu-wsl (WSL provisioning), fu-ce (compound docs), plus /ask-fu as the catalogue/router. fu-pg and fu-pup auto-trigger; the rest are hidden from context and invoked explicitly.

plugins.name: fu-dev-guards
plugins.description: Dev safety guards: worktree path enforcement, protected-branch commit blocking, protected-directory edit + branch-switch blocking, a session-start notice in protected checkouts, a session-id stamp for PR bodies, and dotnet format pre-commit.

plugins.name: fu-statusline
plugins.description: A bash + jq Claude Code status line renderer — drop-in replacement for `npx ccstatusline` at 49x less time and 9x less memory per render; install/uninstall commands patch settings.json.
